[{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg)","line":977,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg(pattern, string [, registers]) receives attacker-controlled regex text from the caller","note":"The PoC controls the regex pattern passed into the mbstring regex engine."},{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":456,"var":"pattern","code":"php_mb_check_encoding(pattern, patlen, _php_mb_regex_mbctype2name(enc))","note":"The pattern is validated as UTF-8 before compilation, so the PoC must be valid UTF-8 while still exercising the vulnerable parser path."},{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":461,"var":"retval","code":"onig_new(&retval, (OnigUChar *)pattern, (OnigUChar *)(pattern + patlen), options, enc, syntax, &err_info)","note":"The validated pattern is compiled by Oniguruma into an internal regex AST and cached for later matching."},{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"node_char_len1","line":707,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) { ... case NODE_ALT: ... case NODE_BACKREF: ... }","note":"During compilation Oniguruma recursively computes character lengths for regex nodes; the crash state indicates this path reaches node_char_len1 repeatedly."},{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"node_char_len1","line":906,"var":"mem_env[backs[0]].mem_node","code":"r = node_char_len1(mem_env[backs[0]].mem_node, reg, ci, env, level);","note":"A backreference causes node_char_len1 to revisit a captured subexpression through mem_env, creating the vulnerable recursive traversal that leads to the heap-use-after-free read."}]
JSON
